crossRefs.note: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
translations.bsb: A second time the angel of the LORD returned and touched him, saying, “Get up and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for thee.
